text.p: SmarTalk TeleServices, Inc said on Friday it named Erich Spangenberg president and chief operating officer.

Spangenberg was most recently a senior vice president in Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette's investment banking group. He also spent 10 years with law firm Jones, Day, Reavis & Pogue where he was a partner in the mergers and acquisitions group.
SmarTalk provides telecommunications products and services and makes and distributes prepaid long distance calling cards.

Company founder Robert Lorsch would keep his postition as chairman and chief executive officer, increasing SmarTalk's focus on strategic alliances, marketing, and relationships with new and existing retailers, it said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
